entities.summary: Michael Ray Turner is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative from Ohio's 10th congressional district since 2013. A member of the Republican Party, he previously represented Ohio's 3rd congressional district (2003-2013). Before that, he served as the mayor of Dayton, Ohio.
